recentItems.title: How Russell Brand became one of Britain’s biggest stars | Russell Brand on Trial
recentItems.description:
Russell Brand’s rape trial began today in London - but who is the man behind the headlines and how did he reach such monumental levels of success in the 2000s? 

In this podcast, Minnie Stephenson talks to journalist and broadcaster Sam Delaney about Russell Brand’s career, his rise to fame and the story behind one of the most recognisable and controversial figures in British entertainment.  

Russell Brand has been charged with three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault. He strenuously denies all charges.

recentItems.title: Vishal Dadlani on ‘Cockroach’ protests: ‘The change we want to see is accountability’
recentItems.description:
Indian singer and composer Vishal Dadlani has criticised the authorities’ response to the ongoing ‘Cockroach’ protests in New Delhi, describing the scenes on the streets as “unprecedented”.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Speaking to Channel 4 News, Dadlani, one half of the Bollywood music duo Vishal–Shekhar, said the government was seeking to quash dissent as young Indians demand answers over electoral transparency and accountability.

Dadlani, who previously took part in India’s 2011 anti-corruption protests, said he remained hopeful that the demonstrations could bring change. He argued that the authorities should engage with protesters and answer their questions, adding that “simply sitting down and having a conversation is better” than using force.
